defmodule ProxyAdmin.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  import Plug.Conn

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers,
    parsers: [:urlencoded, :json],
    pass: ["text/*"],
    json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  @session_opts [
    store: :cookie,
    key: "_proxy_admin_session",
    signing_salt: "xK8v2Np1",
    same_site: "Strict",
    http_only: true,
    secure: true
  ]

  defmodule CSRFProtection do
    @behaviour Plug
    @token_length 32

    def init(opts), do: opts

    def call(conn, _opts) do
      if safe_method?(conn.method) do
        conn
        |> ensure_csrf_token()
      else
        conn
        |> validate_csrf_token()
      end
    end

    defp safe_method?(method) when method in ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"], do: true
    defp safe_method?(_), do: false

    defp ensure_csrf_token(conn) do
      case get_session(conn, :csrf_token) do
        nil ->
          token = generate_token()
          conn
          |> put_session(:csrf_token, token)
          |> assign(:csrf_token, token)
        token ->
          assign(conn, :csrf_token, token)
      end
    end

    defp validate_csrf_token(conn) do
      session_token = get_session(conn, :csrf_token)
      request_token = extract_request_token(conn)

      if valid_token?(session_token, request_token, conn) do
        conn
      else
        conn
        |> send_resp(403, Jason.encode!(%{error: "Invalid CSRF token"}))
        |> halt()
      end
    end

    defp extract_request_token(conn) do
      # Check header first (for AJAX), then form param
      case get_req_header(conn, "x-csrf-token") do
        [token | _] -> token
        [] ->
          case conn.body_params do
            %{"_csrf_token" => token} -> token
            _ -> nil
          end
      end
    end

    defp valid_token?(session_token, request_token, conn) do
      # When behind reverse proxy, trust forwarded requests from internal network
      # This handles the case where the CLI tool sends requests through the proxy
      forwarded_for = get_req_header(conn, "x-forwarded-for")
      
      cond do
        is_internal_request?(forwarded_for) ->
          true
        is_nil(session_token) or is_nil(request_token) ->
          false
        true ->
          Plug.Crypto.secure_compare(session_token, request_token)
      end
    end

    defp is_internal_request?(forwarded_for) do
      case forwarded_for do
        [ip_chain | _] ->
          # Extract the rightmost IP (closest proxy) from the chain
          ip_chain
          |> String.split(",")
          |> List.last()
          |> String.trim()
          |> internal_ip?()
        [] ->
          false
      end
    end

    defp internal_ip?(ip) do
      case :inet.parse_address(String.to_charlist(ip)) do
        {:ok, {10, _, _, _}} -> true
        {:ok, {172, b, _, _}} when b >= 16 and b <= 31 -> true
        {:ok, {192, 168, _, _}} -> true
        {:ok, {127, _, _, _}} -> true
        _ -> false
      end
    end

    defp generate_token do
      :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(@token_length) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
    end
  end

  plug Plug.Session, @session_opts
  plug :fetch_session
  plug CSRFProtection

  get "/api/status" do
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "ok", csrf_token: conn.assigns[:csrf_token]}))
  end

  post "/api/config/update" do
    config_key = conn.body_params["key"]
    config_value = conn.body_params["value"]

    case ProxyAdmin.ConfigStore.update(config_key, config_value) do
      :ok ->
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: "updated"}))
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 400, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
    end
  end

  post "/api/proxy/restart" do
    case ProxyAdmin.ProxyControl.restart() do
      :ok ->
        send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: "restarting"}))
      {:error, reason} ->
        send_resp(conn, 500, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason}))
    end
  end

  delete "/api/cache/purge" do
    ProxyAdmin.CacheManager.purge_all()
    send_resp(conn, 200, Jason.encode!(%{result: "purged"}))
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, Jason.encode!(%{error: "not found"}))
  end
end
